findings.needed: If the owner chooses the option at G21, the edit of the look that carries his choice names the option's narrowest text width (149.3 px at 1207) in 7.7 and 13.3 and the two-line stage word there (or a boundary at which it fits). Nothing to build now: F3 builds the default.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 4 (the named boundary holds what it promises), decision 0123 I2/J2 «so no title breaks inside a word»; AP-158
findings.place: 7.7, lines 662-668 («beside the intro only from 1207 px … Beside the intro the content of a card is 95.7 px at its narrowest, at 1207 [C: the team column (1207 − 2·20 − 36) / 2.25 …], so every word above fits»); 8.1 A, line 889 («≥ 1207 (J2)»)
findings.what: The boundary is a media query on the window width, while the [C] takes the layout width equal to the window width, which is true only for overlay scrollbars (the matrix, macOS). A classic scrollbar of b px (Windows by default; macOS with «Show scroll bars: Always») keeps the media query at 1207 but narrows the layout by b px, and a card's content by b/9 px. Measured in my trial with a classic 15-px scrollbar (a page that scrolls, the decision's rule): content 94.0 at 1207, «спецификацию» broken inside the word at 1207, 1210, 1215, 1220 and 1221 px, none from 1222 (clientWidth 1207). With overlay scrollbars the margin is 0.06 px (95.66 against the word's 95.60–95.61), and another font stack gives other widths (AP-158; step 03g issue I6). The guard `overflow-wrap: anywhere` keeps the card from overflowing (no cut, no horizontal scroll), and DESIGN-QA's matrix windows are not in the band, so no check sees it. The look carries the record's boundary exactly; the gap belongs to the boundary's definition.
findings.needed: ORCH decides (decision 0123's line, then an edit of the look with its own check if the boundary changes): keep 1207 and add the classic-scrollbar band to 7.7's reason and to D8 (as 9.1 does for the scale), or move the boundary so that it holds with a classic scrollbar and a margin for the font stack (for example from 1240 px, where `.wrap` caps and the content is 99.3 px at s 3; or a rule on the hero's own width instead of the window's). Not blocking for F3: the default and its 1207 rule are what the records say.
